# 1080p: investigate and improve the explanation with evidence

**Status:** Active endpoint planning; implementation packets follow actual 720p evidence

**Parent:** [Roadmap](../roadmap.md#1080p-investigate-and-improve-the-explanation-with-evidence); [delivery execution contract](../delivery-through-1080p.md)

**Owner:** Root coordinates; assigned agents implement and independently review bounded slices

## Outcome and sequence

Challenge a claim, execute a configured bounded check without stopping review, compare actual base/head evidence and retain a correction through source-backed agent enrichment.

| Slice | Contract to settle before implementation | Required real own-PR outcome |
|---|---|---|
| 06: head test job | Explicit existing repository target IDs mapped to argv/working directory, isolated pinned head worktree, environment/artifact limits, durable job/cancel transitions and launch reconciliation. No arbitrary shell field, recursive active dogfood harness, global install or hidden network/credential grant. | Run a relevant configured target from UI, inspect same result via CLI, continue commenting, observe success/failure and cancellation confirmed or unknown. Test presence is separate from execution. |
| 07: compare base/head | Same configured intent on two pinned sources, separate worktrees/results and explicit command/environment/content differences. Unavailable baseline target is an incompatible comparison, not a pass or fabricated result. | Inspect the actual two runs and state what the difference supports; known mismatch/missing evidence stays visible. |
| 08: retain correction/enrichment | Correction identity/provenance and graph CAS, generation-scoped agent actions, durable subscribed terminal-event inbox eligibility, causal suppression of own replies/updates and no overwritten human correction. | Challenge a claim, preserve correction through agent enrichment/reopen and inspect whether the actual evidence resolved the uncertainty. |

Create each slice page and versioned implementation/independent-review packets only when predecessor interfaces and the concrete task are known. Before its UI work, select a real PR/trigger and source-backed expected account in a separate verifier packet. Use strict TypeScript, tested domain policy, real process evidence, actual React E2E and every-PR graph-first critique. No test job may hold a database transaction or serialize unrelated comments behind process execution.

## Delivered720p predecessor knowledge and dispatch limit

The [05C handoff](../720p/slices/05-explanation-exploration/checkpoint-05c.md#independent-knowledge-recheck-and-current-gates) pins delivered public story/claim/source/version/reference, draft/frame/recovery and shared job/lease boundaries. Its bounded engineering code iscd3e134 after the startup hydration correction; whole-current-product design rebuild readiness is independently qualified YES at knowledgecd3e134 after the startup-delta recheck (priorc0 F1–F3 closure/122 standalone calculations carried forward). Root's actual reviewed/imported own-PR target remains48d6cf1, separately from later evidence-only delivery. The qualified knowledge result does not establish an actual rebuild/source-conformance/product-test/native/own-PR/human/deployment outcome or accept full05/720p/original04 G14. The confirmed pre-Resume startup false-login alert is independently closed; the original live first-Resume failure itself remains UNPROVEN. Root preserves baseline48/story/key while preparing content correction and a regenerated final target/key/references; no operational action is implied by this handoff.

An external06 readiness proposal is retained at `/tmp/pr-reviewer-720p-reflection-evidence/slice06-readiness.md`; no06 implementation packet/dispatch is adopted here. Root must settle its concrete configured target/environment/isolation/task and assign versioned implementation/independent-review roles before derived code. This successor reconciliation creates no execution controls, runtime effects or extra hierarchy.

## Exit and known limits

Exit requires 06–08 source/environment/result identity, cancellation/unknown recovery, comparison honesty, retained correction and no wake loops; independent review and actual own-PR graph-first critique must pass. Earlier 480p/720p native/human acceptance gaps remain open until actually resolved. Record implemented/tested/merged/pilot-verified status separately; do not call 1080p fully accepted solely because these three slices pass engineering tests.

Passkey is a known issue deferred to the final follow-up after this endpoint's engineering delivery. Preserve the current login and all credentials/data; no authentication change, public deployment, new host or external posting is part of these slices. If only external human/access decisions remain, record precise morning actions while finishing all independent authorized work.

## Mandatory round reflection and rebuild-readiness gate

Before round acceptance, complete the [round reflection protocol](../../rules/round-reflection.md): an assigned agent reflects on actual code/structure and the best design if rebuilding now, promotes learned knowledge into durable product docs, then a fresh auditor evaluates whole-current-product rebuild readiness using product/rule docs only, excluding plans, chat and application code. Correct material gaps before passing; an audit is not an actual reimplementation claim. Keep native/human/execution gates independent. This gate remains unrun for this round and does not stop independent ready implementation.

**Owner:** Maintainer owns material decisions; slice owners deliver and reconcile evidence

**Authorization:** Autonomous delivery through 1080p with committed bounded packets; existing private local pilot authority only. Preserve login, data, sessions and network routes.

## Outcome and scope

Complete one rough real review in the originating Codex and Claude sessions, then continue it without losing questions, answers or immutable source identity. This is increasing product fidelity, not a screen-resolution target. Keep bounded source preparation and add a minimum read-only evidence-linked graph in slice 02 for mandatory graph-first review; general import, semantic calls, test execution and whole-PR narration remain later rounds.

## Slice sequence

| Slice | Plan and dependency | Required contribution to the next plan |
|---|---|---|
| 01: ask about one behavior | [Implementation and acceptance](slices/01-review-loop/plan.md); each host needs its own actual CLI/MCP product evidence | Supply slice 02 with actual snapshot/anchor, attachment generation, receipt/read-model and inbox/cursor contracts, restart evidence, per-host capabilities and remaining limitations. |
| 02: continue the same review | [Packet v1](slices/02-review-continuation/plan.md); reconciles reviewed 01 interfaces; bootstrap graph and history can implement while native/human acceptance remains open | Supply slice 03's provisional plan with snapshot/history contracts, verified source preparation and recovery limits, so general import preserves those boundaries. |

Each slice has implementation and independent-review handoffs under the [shared contract](../../rules/agent-handoffs.md). 01-Codex and 01-Claude are separately verified host variants of the same slice, not separate horizontal UI/backend slices. Slice 02 must also prove continuation per host.

## Shared gates and exit evidence

- [Existing-session integration checks](probes/00-host-contract.md): reuse established CLI notification and MCP reply mechanisms; verify exact binding, authorization and truthful recovery in each product host path. No generic feasibility experiment blocks coding.
- [Comprehension packet](evaluation.md), following the [shared evaluation rule](../../rules/comprehension.md): select the real task, source-backed expected account, evaluator and threshold before presentation implementation. Prospective criterion selected; actual unfamiliar-human run remains unrun.
- [Own-PR dogfood](../../rules/own-pr-dogfood.md): every slice uses its real PR with candidate identity separate from pinned reviewed baseline/head; fixes require affected checks to run again.
- Named implementation/run target and execution authority, strict TypeScript, all-code testing/TDD, actual React E2E and design-principle review and managed subsystem boundaries remain required.

Exit requires both host variants of slice 01, slice 02 continuation for each, the agreed comprehension result, independent review and reconciled successor plans. Saved, delivered, turn complete and answered remain distinct. A new head cannot silently re-anchor old discussion. Controlled-host product/code checks passed for the pinned slice01 candidate; full native-host, complete dogfood and human comprehension remain incomplete.

## Progress and next action

The [current execution contract](../delivery-through-1080p.md) supersedes the former blanket slice02 block with capability-specific readiness. Dispatch [slice02 v1](slices/02-review-continuation/plan.md) against merged public interfaces; run bounded [slice03 acquisition preparation](../720p/slices/03-whole-change/plan.md) in parallel with separate ownership. Root supplies exact executor/worktree/source identity. Actual acceptance and any host/browser-control failure remain recorded, not assumed passed. Every new PR receives actual UI/graph-first understanding review.

## Own-PR readiness

The [PR 14 bootstrap task](slices/01-review-loop/bootstrap-task.md) is selected and its source verified; candidate build and actual product dogfood evidence are produced by implementation, not invented during planning. Each slice records its own qualifying PR/task and evidence in its local plan under the [shared dogfood rule](../../rules/own-pr-dogfood.md).

## Mandatory round reflection and rebuild-readiness gate

Before round acceptance, complete the [round reflection protocol](../../rules/round-reflection.md): an assigned agent reflects on actual code/structure and the best design if rebuilding now, promotes learned knowledge into durable product docs, then a fresh auditor evaluates whole-current-product rebuild readiness using product/rule docs only, excluding plans, chat and application code. Correct material gaps before passing; an audit is not an actual reimplementation claim. Keep native/human/execution gates independent. # Slice 01: ask about one real behavior (480p)

**Status:** Runnable code delivery independently accepted at e24ce7c; full native-host, dogfood and human slice acceptance pending

**Parent:** [480p round plan](../../plan.md)

**Design:** [High-level design](../../../../product/architecture.md)

**Owner:** Implementing agent owns the slice; maintainer resolves material product, host and execution-scope decisions

**Authorization:** Dispatched bounded local implementation, dependencies, tests and loopback runtime authorized; PR-only delivery; no production deployment.

## Readiness and preparation

Use the [readiness audit](readiness.md) for missing pre-implementation inputs versus later review/acceptance evidence. The [selected bootstrap task](bootstrap-task.md) pins our real PR 14, source spans and source-backed account. [Execution](execution.md), [implementation handoff](handoffs/implementation.md) and [independent-review handoff](handoffs/review.md) make the next assignment concrete.

## Outcome and gap

A reviewer sees one pinned real before/after behavior change, posts a question on its exact source context, and receives a source-backed reply from the responsible agent in the exact attached conversation. The reviewer can explain the difference, a relevant consequence and the evidence and uncertainty behind the answer. This first runnable slice must be dogfoodable on our own real PR under the [per-slice dogfood contract](../../../../rules/own-pr-dogfood.md).

The local React/SQLite/MCP candidate now exists; [implementation evidence](implementation-evidence.md) distinguishes controlled-host checks from native-host and human acceptance. The [existing-session integration checks](../../probes/00-host-contract.md) reuse known CLI/MCP mechanisms and verify the product adapter as it is built. The [comprehension protocol](../../../../rules/comprehension.md) establishes the task and expected account before presentation implementation.

## Two independently testable host deliveries

Deliver **01-Codex** and **01-Claude** as bounded variants of this same end-to-end contract, following the [participant adapter plan](../../../../product/participant-adapters.md). The initiating existing session is THE attached session; neither path may silently create or fork a replacement. Each gets its own actual CLI/MCP integration evidence, own-PR dogfood record, candidate/target/session identity and 01-A through 01-G evidence. Shared domain/UI checks can be reused; real-host evidence cannot. Either may go first when ready. Both are required before calling the dual-host slice complete, and slice 02 repeats continuation per host. Supporting both types does not allow simultaneous owners of one attachment.

The [functional/reactive design](../../../../product/reactive-design.md) governs domain/effect boundaries. Library evaluation must not become a prerequisite for the host-only probe.

## Prepared implementation inputs

| Input | Current disposition |
|---|---|
| App/agent direction | App → CLI → exact existing session; agent → MCP → authoritative app state. Reuse established queue/Playground mechanisms; [integration checks](../../probes/00-host-contract.md) replace generic host feasibility research. |
| Real source and account | Selected [PR 14](bootstrap-task.md), pinned base/head, before/after spans, concrete question and expected answer. No maintainer example-selection blocker. |
| Product behavior and detailed design | [Maintained review-loop specification](../../../../product/review-loop/README.md): user story, data/public/MCP contracts, pairing, notification, recovery and React UI principles. |
| Run and test approach | [Execution plan](execution.md): actual local Node/Bun/Chrome locations, task-local data, start/stop behavior, TDD sequence and 01-A–G checks. [Experiments](experiments.md) preserve actual results and limits. |
| Evaluation criterion | [480p packet](../../evaluation.md) fixes the prospective task/rubric. Actual human observation follows a runnable candidate; missing human results are not a code-start blocker. |
| Agent assignments | [Implementation](handoffs/implementation.md) and [review](handoffs/review.md) packets define roles, reads, scope, checks, return and stop conditions. Dispatch adds exact agent/worktree/source revision; implementation later supplies the real review candidate. |

No product test is claimed before the product exists. A concrete failing host route blocks that route's acceptance, not all independently ready implementation. Full dual-host, own-PR and human acceptance remain required at the end.

## Included path and boundaries

1. Load one bounded real source snapshot prepared from verified baseline/head objects: enough before/after context for the chosen behavior and consequence, with immutable snapshot/side/path/span anchors. Show both sides, labeled additions/removals/modifications and explicit missing context. General PR import and semantic graph analysis are excluded.
2. Present readable source and a question/reply surface using React controls following the referenced design guidelines and principles. Include basic keyboard access, focus and readable labels. UI collects intent and renders queries; review rules live in domain/application interfaces.
3. Bind the authenticated user and responsible agent to the verified host conversation and attachment generation. Persist the anchored question through durable command ingress; atomically commit state, receipt and addressed event/outbox. Attachment, inbox and reply mutations use the same domain-write boundary. Reads use the authorized read model.
4. Deliver only the eligible addressed request through a durable inbox and the verified host adapter. Persist a stable invocationId distinct from commandId before the external effect. Release the dispatcher transaction before host work; serialize conversation turns only. The turn must be able to issue MCP queries and commands without waiting on a lock it holds.
5. Let that exact conversation read the pinned source/question through supported MCP and submit a source-backed reply through the same permitted domain actions. Recheck identity, permissions and attachment generation when the queued write applies. Do not trust caller-supplied actor strings.
6. Read the reply from authoritative persisted state and display it with its source evidence and limitations. A receipt/query must meet the resulting revision/cursor or explicitly expose projection pending. A local optimistic echo or host transcript alone is not reply acceptance.

Persist basic inbox items, cursors, consumption and causal references so restart cannot lose accepted questions. Own replies and delivery receipts are ineligible wake triggers. Ordinary graph updates and subscribed terminal jobs are not implemented here; their wake policy remains governed by the architecture when introduced. Product labels distinguish saved, pending/delivered, turn started/completed and answered. Turn completion alone does not mean a reply exists.

Cross-subsystem updates between the review read model, view-store and participant delivery use declared public-port routes in the managed integration layer. Keep registration, scoped ownership, teardown and diagnostics together; no component or business module subscribes directly to another subsystem’s internals. The first slice tests duplicate registration, dispose/reconnect, revoked scope and late emissions alongside its real journey. Start with the few routes this path needs, not a generic stream platform.

## Acceptance and verification

Use domain and adapter tests, preferably TDD, then the actual user journey. All code must be tested. Record the source version, host/environment, test commands, artifact references, observations and limits in this document as evidence arrives.

| Acceptance | Required evidence |
|---|---|
| **01-A — A real anchored question gets an authoritative reply.** UI save → exact host turn → MCP source/question read → reply command → persisted query → browser display all refer to the same immutable anchor and attachment. | E2E with the React UI behavior and design-guideline conformance and real selected host; inspect the saved receipt and readback, not only rendered text. Separately identify accepted command, delivery, turn and answered states. |
| **01-B — The agent can make progress during its own turn.** A real MCP read/reply command completes while that same host turn is active. | Real-turn evidence plus transaction/locking tests show no transaction or participant-wide command lock spans the host/MCP wait. A controlled slow adapter can test local lock behavior only; it cannot prove real-host progress or independent long-job behavior. |
| **01-C — Retry and restart preserve one accepted mutation and every eligible item.** Identical command retry returns the original receipt; changed-payload commandId reuse is rejected. | Domain/adapter tests and persisted restart readback around comment/reply commit and inbox consumption. Recover cursors and coalesced addressed items without duplicate writes or lost questions. Slice 02 later expands this into the complete reopen/new-head user journey. |
| **01-D — Invalid identity, generation and anchors cannot mutate the review.** Revoke permission or replace attachment while a write is queued; the old write fails at apply time. Wrong snapshot/side/path/span is rejected. | Negative domain/interface tests and authenticated boundary checks; reply remains attributed to the verified actor and original source. Rejections leave no partial state. Comments use anchor validation, not an unrelated graph-wide revision. |
| **01-E — Uncertain wakeups remain honest.** Lost acknowledgement is queried/reconciled by invocationId or shown as unknown/pending, never blindly relaunched. Replies/receipts do not wake the agent again. | Product adapter fault tests, available owner/queue correlation and actual integrated MCP readback, and inbox eligibility tests. A fixture cannot establish missing host capabilities. |
| **01-F — The reviewer can inspect and explain the result.** Keyboard navigation reaches source, question and answer; diff labels work without color alone; evidence links reach the original source. | Actual React browser E2E for interaction plus the separately recorded unfamiliar-reviewer session against the predeclared [rubric](../../../../rules/comprehension.md). Unsupported/wrong substantive claims fail. Implementer self-check is separate evidence. |
| **01-G — We can use the candidate to review our own PR.** Ask about one implemented behavior or source-backed changed-document claim in our actual slice PR and inspect the persisted answer and its source. | Record the real PR URL and exact baseline/head, candidate source/build/runtime identity, acquisition method, observed question/reply/readback, pass condition and gaps using the [dogfood record](../../../../rules/own-pr-dogfood.md). Manual pinned-source preparation is allowed; it proves neither a general importer nor unsupported code analysis/test execution. Fixes or head changes require relevant revalidation. Same-agent dogfood does not satisfy 01-F's unfamiliar-reviewer evidence. |

## Deferred acceptance and exclusions

- **Slice 02:** Full user-facing reopen/follow-up and a new pinned head, with old discussions retained historically. Basic persistence/restart correctness of this slice remains required now.
- **Slice 03:** General PR import, whole-change coverage and the first real independent background job. Prove comments progress during that real job there. A simulated delay here is no substitute.
- **Slice 04:** Semantic relationships, React Flow, shared graph annotations and atomic graph CAS/conflict behavior. No graph mutation exists here to claim tested; source anchors and comment concurrency remain required.
- **Slice 06:** Configured repository tests, real process execution, job cancellation and terminal-outcome evidence. Slice 01 does not need a fake long-running job or a repository runner to prove the question/reply path.
- **Later slices:** Whole-PR narration/player, enrichment, advanced zoom/mobile refinement, additional hosts/languages and mature performance. No production deployment, hosted agent runtime or external PR posting.

These are feature deferrals, not architecture exceptions. Short atomic dispatch, independent jobs when introduced, action-specific CAS, turn-only serialization, apply-time authorization, stable external invocation identities and explicit unknowns remain required by the [design](../../../../product/architecture.md).

## Delivery order, evidence and stop conditions

At implementation dispatch, follow the execution and handoff packets: (1) derive failing tests for the bounded source/command/attachment interfaces; (2) implement the minimum source-to-question-to-reply path through those public interfaces; (3) exercise the real host and React E2E, then the comprehension session; (4) reconcile observed gaps here before expanding into slice 02. Tests cover the responsible domain and application policies independently of UI adapters. The internal build steps are not separate horizontal product slices.

The effort boundary is one behavior, one snapshot, one responsible conversation and one complete question/reply journey. Stop dependent work and revise the source contract if host behavior contradicts the probe, identity/source evidence cannot be verified, or the agreed expected account is wrong or incomplete. Preserve accepted questions and unknown invocation references for reconciliation; do not broaden into a new host, analyzer, runner or permissions workaround to finish the slice.

The [implementation evidence](implementation-evidence.md) records passing strict checks, domain/interface/process tests and a controlled-host React/stdio MCP journey against PR 14. Full 01-A through 01-G acceptance remains unmet: actual native-host tool integration, real-host own-PR dogfood and unfamiliar-reviewer comprehension remain explicit gates. Independent code delivery is accepted for `e24ce7c465857f5f277f3926b01342628b7ddee7` in the [final review receipt](reviews/implementation-e24ce7c.md). The first milestone was subsequently merged in PR19 and a private main-source pilot documented in PR20; the historical checks remain attributed to their exact candidate. This is not evidence that native/human acceptance passed.

## Agent handoffs and successor contribution

The [implementation packet](handoffs/implementation.md) and [independent-review packet](handoffs/review.md) follow the [shared handoff contract](../../../../rules/agent-handoffs.md). The dispatcher supplies the exact committed packet and assigned task workspace. Candidate identity and executed product results are furnished after implementation, before review; they are not prerequisites to writing code.

Before acceptance, promote the actual question/reply user story, source/attachment/receipt/inbox interfaces, state transitions, authorization/failure/recovery semantics and relevant design rationale into durable product docs outside plans. ## Traceability and constraints across slices

| Vision / architecture requirement | First delivery and later refinement | Evidence boundary |
|---|---|---|
| Purpose and before/after behavior | 01; graph-led account in 04–05 | [Comprehension packet](../rules/comprehension.md) precedes presentation; transport success is insufficient. |
| Whole scope, supporting changes and dependencies | 03 coverage; 04 relationships; 05 exploration/story | Coverage, resolved source facts and reviewer understanding are separate checks. |
| Claims, tests and confidence with reasons | 01 source-backed reply; 04 related test source; 06 execution; 07 comparison; 08 enrichment | Static test presence is not execution, and successful execution proves only its bounded claim. |
| Durable conversation and corrections | 01 anchored question/reply; 02 continuation/history; 04 annotation; 08 correction retention | Exact actor, attachment generation, snapshot and reply must be proven, not supplied as trusted strings. |
| Commands, jobs and external effects | 01 ingress/receipts/turn delivery; 03 import job; 04 graph CAS; 06 test/cancel; 08 terminal-event wakeup | Short atomic transactions, separate jobs, turn-only serialization and stable invocationId remain required at first use. |
| Self-use on each delivered increment | 01–12, with [per-slice dogfood evidence](../rules/own-pr-dogfood.md) | Candidate provenance and reviewed baseline/head are separate; same-agent dogfood is not unfamiliar-reviewer evidence. |
| Orientation and realistic access | 01 readable labeled source/basic keyboard; 05 player; 09 density; 10 phone/assistive use; 11 recovery | Browser checks, human comprehension, physical device and screen-reader evidence remain separate. |

All domain writes use durable ingress; authorized reads use the query read model. Business rules belong to the responsible subsystem behind a public interface, not UI components. Transactions atomically commit state, receipts, events/outbox and relevant job creation, then end before external work. Agent MCP commands must progress during the agent's own serialized turn. Apply-time authorization/generation, action-specific concurrency and receipt-aware readback apply from the first relevant command. External invocationId is distinct from commandId; unknown outcomes are reconciled, never blindly replayed. Wakeups have explicit eligibility and durable inbox/consumption state. See the [architecture](../product/architecture.md) for the complete contract; deferred features do not weaken it.

Every slice that introduces or changes a cross-subsystem stream must declare it through the managed integration layer, record its owner/scope and teardown, and test route boundaries, authorization, duplicate registration, cleanup, errors and slow-consumer behavior. Own-PR E2E inspects the relevant subscription diagnostics. No scattered direct subscriptions or hidden feedback loops are accepted; see the [reactive integration contract](../product/reactive-design.md).

All code must be tested, preferably through TDD. Each slice needs domain/interface tests and E2E for its actual user journey, using real decompozr/design-system guidelines and design principles. Record source version, environment, commands, artifacts, actual outcomes and limits. Simulations support only the boundary exercised. No fixtures, previous prototype receipts or document checks count as real-host, real-process, device or comprehension acceptance.

## Decisions, progress and next action

Use [delivery through 1080p](delivery-through-1080p.md) as the current execution contract. Slice 02 bootstraps actual graph review before continuation; slice 03 acquisition preparation can run in parallel under separate ownership. Both native hosts and human evaluation remain acceptance requirements without blocking unrelated engineering. TypeScript/TSX is the bounded initial 04 analysis scope; parser precision and target runner/comparison details are resolved in their committed packets, not inferred from current tests.

Every new PR/MR follows [graph-first understanding review](../rules/graph-first-review.md), including any separate planning PR after a versioned bootstrap candidate exists. Passkey remains a known issue deferred to the last follow-up; preserve login and data now. 4K scope is provisional and outside the requested endpoint. The retained Playground prototype remains a read-only reference, never an application restoration source. Hosted agents, generalized ownership, remote workers and external PR posting remain deferred.

# High-level design

**Status:** Accepted direction, documented for further refinement

**Implementation:** Bounded React/SQLite/CLI/MCP milestone and read-only source graph merged. Immutable continuation/history has bounded independent engineering and actual own-PR navigation acceptance. Native Codex/Claude journey, full slice and unfamiliar-human acceptance remain separately open.

## From vision to system

The [product vision](vision.md) calls for a connected understanding of changed behavior, with inspectable evidence and room for questions. The system brings source facts, agent interpretation and execution evidence into one review while keeping their identities and limits distinct.

The reviewer can enter at a behavior or a source detail, follow relationships and return without losing context. A compact context rail separates Epic/Ticket/PR source material from agent understanding, with provenance, freshness and explicit missing information. Behavioral groups account for the whole PR, including supporting configuration, documentation and tests.

Within a group, before-left and after-right source nodes expose colored changes alongside unchanged context, source-anchored explanations and related tests. Red means removal, green addition and yellow modification, with labels beyond color. There is no before/after mode toggle. One-hop callers and callees include unchanged dependencies and both source sides; unresolved relationships remain distinct from confirmed leaves.

The graph leads the explanation. Plain-English narration explains the already-highlighted behavior with a brief why, what/how and concrete example. Semantic zoom and manual expansion reveal detail without changing identity or losing selection. There is no API/Helpers orientation selector.

Preserve the slim, draggable bottom-center player: drag, previous, replay/pause, next and step count/chapter selection in one row. Mobile Flow/Diff shares the story cursor, reading pause and exploration/resume state. Icons serve operations with accessible names/tooltips; text carries review information. These are experience constraints for progressive delivery, not claims about an existing app.

## Technology direction

**Frontend:** React 19

**Canvas:** React Flow

**Frontend tooling:** Vite

**UI guidelines and principles:** decompozr/design-system; React implementation only, no Svelte dependency

**Backend runtime:** Node.js

**Application language:** TypeScript with strict mode for frontend and backend

**Linting and formatting:** Tool selection deferred; Biome is not required

**Durable data:** SQLite

**Evidence storage:** Referenced source snapshots, patches and execution artifact files

These are accepted technology directions. The first milestone derived strict TypeScript settings and a bounded application from slice 01. Later subsystems remain planned; see the [current delivery plan](../plans/delivery-through-1080p.md) and [continuation/import boundary](review-loop/evolution.md).

## Development rules

Follow the [implementation conventions](../rules/development.md) for strict TypeScript, functional preferences and React pattern selection. This document owns the product architecture; shared development rules have one home.

## System diagram

```mermaid
flowchart TB
  User[User participant] --> UI[React UI / React Flow]
  Agent[Originating agent participant] --> Codex[Codex participant adapter]
  Agent --> Claude[Claude participant adapter]
  Codex --> MCP[Shared MCP operations]
  Claude --> MCP
  CLI[CLI] --> Gateway[Authenticated gateway]
  UI --> Gateway
  MCP --> Gateway
  Gateway -->|Authorized queries| Read[Read model]
  Gateway -->|Domain commands| Queue[Durable command ingress]
  Queue --> Dispatcher[Dispatcher / short transactions]
  Dispatcher -->|Atomic commit| DB[(SQLite: state / receipts / events / outbox / jobs)]
  DB --> Read
  Read -->|Committed updates| UI
  Read -->|Query results| Gateway
  DB -->|Durable jobs| Workers[Independent analysis / test workers]
  Workers --> Artifacts[Isolated worktrees / evidence files]
  Workers -->|Authenticated result commands| Queue
  DB -->|Eligible addressed events| Inbox[Durable participant inbox]
  Inbox --> Scheduler[Turn scheduler / Codex or Claude host bridge]
  Scheduler -->|Verified binding / invocationId| Conversation[Exact attached conversation]
  Conversation -->|Executes a turn| Agent
```

## Subsystem boundaries

| Subsystem | Owns | Boundary |
|---|---|---|
| Review presentation | Canvas, context rail, story controls, exploration and private viewport | Renders read models and submits intent. Business rules remain outside UI components. |
| Review domain | Snapshots, coverage, groups, anchors, annotations, comments and shared focus | Validates domain commands through explicit interfaces, independent of transport and renderer. |
| Command processing | Durable ingress, receipts, deduplication and short atomic dispatch | UI, MCP, CLI and worker results use the same write path; jobs execute elsewhere. |
| Source preparation | Bounded manual/provider pinned manifests, identity compatibility and verification witnesses | No database writes. Gateway verifies outside transactions; storage admits new source only with a matching nonserialized review/manifest witness. The candidate acquisition-v1 adapter preserves provider IDs and issues job/review/manifest-bound witnesses. |
| Source analysis | Pinned source facts, diff coverage and candidate relationships | Returns evidence-backed results; cannot declare agent interpretation as parsed fact. |
| Execution and evidence | Configured test targets, durable jobs, process outcomes and artifacts | Returns result commands; cannot equate request acceptance with a passing test. |
| Participant delivery | Attachments, durable inbox and conversation-turn scheduling | A host adapter proves actual conversation delivery and reconciles uncertain wakeups. |
| Reactive integration | Declared public-port routes, managed subscriptions, scoped teardown and diagnostics | All cross-subsystem streams pass here; no direct internal-module subscriptions, hidden reciprocal wiring or replacement for durable command processing. |
| Persistence adapters | Transactions, projections and artifact storage | Expose contracts to the responsible subsystem; no UI, agent or worker writes around domain ingress. |

These are logical boundaries, not a requirement for separate services. A subsystem exposes a narrow public interface; consumers do not reach into its internals. Domain policy is tested independently of UI and transport adapters.

## Existing-session and functional boundaries

Support [Codex and Claude participant adapters](participant-adapters.md). The session initiating attachment in the current project is the exact responsible session; preserve its host owner, work and permissions. Both integrations are part of 480p, with independent probe and real own-PR evidence. A clone on another machine does not imply shared runtime state or access to a session on this machine.

Use a [functional core with reactive coordination](reactive-design.md): pure domain transitions, isolated effects, explicit lifecycle ownership and UI snapshot subscriptions. Reactive-library selection remains open; no stream library replaces durable commands or makes external effects exactly once. Cross-subsystem wiring is centralized in a declared integration layer and monitored subscription registry. Routes remain scoped, authorized and fault-isolated; central control does not mean one global serial worker.

## Commands, jobs and conversation turns

User and agent are authenticated participants using the same permitted actions through different entry points. Server-derived identity determines the actor; a supplied participant or conversation string is not proof of identity. Workers use scoped execution identities.

Every domain write uses durable command ingress: comments, replies, graph edits, shared focus, test requests, cancellation, attachment/inbox changes and internal results. Authorized reads go directly through the read model. Local hover and viewport stay private.

The dispatcher atomically commits domain state, a command receipt, events/outbox and any job creation. Transactions end before network calls, process execution or agent turns. Queue ordering follows consistency boundaries; it is not a global serial worker. Long jobs do not block comments.

Serialize conversation turns only. An agent awaiting MCP or a job must not hold a participant-wide command lock or domain transaction needed to satisfy its own request.

A successful test-request command means a job exists. Job launch, execution and terminal outcome require separate evidence. Cancellation records intent; cancelled requires confirmed termination. Missing launch or exit evidence remains unknown. External launches and wakeups use stable invocationId distinct from commandId, with host deduplication/query/reconciliation. Outbox replay does not guarantee exactly-once external effects. Unknown launch outcomes cannot be blindly retried; reuse of commandId with changed payload is rejected.

Attachments bind a verified host/conversation, generation and capabilities. Authorization and generation are rechecked when queued writes apply. Stale agent writes are rejected; independently authorized older jobs may retain correctly attributed historical results. A turn, a job and a participant have separate identities.

Wakeups come from addressed user requests or subscribed terminal job events. Own replies, ordinary graph changes and delivery receipts do not wake the agent again. Durable inbox items, cursors, consumption records and causal links survive restart. Coalescing wakeups retains every event. Saved, delivered, turn started, completed and answered remain distinct; unsupported wakeup is visibly pending/degraded.

Concurrency is action-specific: comments validate snapshot/anchor, resource edits use their own revision, and atomic graph patches use graph CAS. Unrelated comments do not invalidate graph edits. Receipts expose resulting revisions/cursors so queries provide read-your-writes or explicit projection-pending state.

## Source and evidence boundaries

Pin the PR head and the actual comparison baseline. Prepare an isolated head worktree and read-only baseline view; use a baseline execution worktree only for an actual comparison run. Resolve callers/callees from both sides, including removed callers and unchanged dependencies. Missing source and binary patches stay explicit. Import does not execute installation hooks.

Source anchors identify snapshot, side, path and span independently of graph layout. A new head creates a new snapshot; old comments/results remain historical. Coverage counts primary changed hunks once even when groups share context.

Keep parsed facts, agent interpretation and execution evidence separate. Role, mock/stub technique and reasoned risk are independent dimensions. Helpers are not inherently low-risk; request/response adapter describes repetitive mapping more precisely than assuming generated code. Human corrections survive enrichment.

Test source changes, relevance and execution results are different claims. Results identify actual worktree content/dirty state, environment, configured command, exit outcome and artifacts; a head SHA alone does not describe modified files. Base/head comparisons preserve separate results and environment differences.

## Delivery and validation

Follow the [progressive roadmap](../plans/roadmap.md), with testable vertical slices inside each round. Use established CLI session delivery and the [scoped integration checks](../plans/480p/probes/00-host-contract.md); App notifies the agent through CLI and the agent reads/replies through MCP. A generic host-feasibility experiment is not a prerequisite to product code. Define the [comprehension task and source-backed expected account](../rules/comprehension.md) before presentation implementation. The first product slice then proves the actual anchored question/reply journey. All code is tested, preferably through TDD. End-to-end checks exercise the real user journey and React UI behavior and design-guideline conformance; fixtures do not establish native host delivery, physical-device behavior or comprehension.

Every product slice must be [dogfoodable using our own real PR](../rules/own-pr-dogfood.md), with the candidate source/build identified separately from the reviewed baseline/head and source anchors. The first runnable slice may use explicitly manual pinned-source acquisition; it does not claim a general importer or unsupported analysis/execution. Fixes and target-head changes require relevant revalidation. Same-agent dogfood is separate from unfamiliar-reviewer comprehension; the host feasibility probe is not product dogfood.

The [first review-loop design](review-loop/README.md) defines concrete interfaces, state and CLI/MCP direction. Verify exact attachment, authorization, notification and MCP reply in the implementation; reuse earlier CLI/Playground knowledge instead of classifying the basic mechanism as unknown. The first supported source language and configured repository test runner also need explicit selection before their respective analysis and execution slices; neither is required for the host-only probe. Real independent-job acceptance begins with whole-PR import, and graph CAS acceptance begins with graph-writing behavior, as scoped in the roadmap. These deferrals do not weaken the architectural contracts. The earlier Playground prototype is a reference, not a running implementation in this repository.

Hosted agent runtime, Decisions integration, generalized multi-agent ownership, remote workers and automatic external PR posting are deferred. This document defines a design-only endpoint; it does not authorize runtime implementation, installation or deployment.


The slice03 candidate adds source-acquisition (read-only provider/Git values), import-jobs (one async owner and tracked processes) and import-artifacts (bounded private files, no authority) through public ports. The existing store owns job/review/receipt atomicity. React import presentation consumes application action/read models; it cannot schedule subprocesses. Exact ownership, restart, trust, persisted formats and current limits are maintained in [durable import jobs](review-loop/import-jobs.md). Candidate implementation/review status is separate from deployed-main evidence.

| Observation | Effect certainty and retained state | Next explicit action |
|---|---|---|

| Mandatory pending write/readback fails before the first POST | Known unsent; keep the draft and reserved in-memory intent, report storage failure. No mutation effect. | Retry its checkpoint before sending; never use a memory-only durability fallback. |
| Exact pending request is checkpointed; acknowledgement is lost, malformed, mismatching, or HTTP400/401/403 fails | Commit may have occurred. Keep the original request bytes/command ID/draft/scope; command_conflict also preserves uncertainty. | Authenticate with the original credential and explicitly recover the unchanged command. | Matching authoritative rejected receipt, excluding command_conflict | That exact request was rejected. Remove only its matching pending guard; retain its draft. A malformed rejection is not authoritative. | Correct through a new explicit intent/command identity. |
| Matching applied receipt; exact question readback absent or unavailable | Retain accepted-awaiting-readback and receipt questionId/minimum revision. | Exact questionId/actor/trimmed text/full anchor/parent confirmed at the minimum | Invalidate/verify only the original private draft ID, preserving the other draft, then remove/verify the matching pending record. Logout/authentication errors cannot erase uncertainty. Saved questions are immutable; deliberate side/range edits apply only to an unsent draft in its held comparison, never to a submitted request.

Authorized attachment replacement/reconnect transfers unanswered durable inbox items to the new generation while retaining their event IDs/cursors and the complete original notification history/destination. Newly saved unaddressed questions gain an item normally. The new generation begins inbox reading at cursor zero, explicitly returned as `inboxCursor: 0` by session_attach; stale credentials remain fenced.

Manual preparation resolves each pinned `commit:path` to a Git **blob** before reading bytes. For legacy single-path preparation, trees, missing objects, NUL-containing binary content and invalid UTF-8 reject as `source_unavailable` before any source input, snapshot or review is persisted. Multi-file preparation retains such changed-side dispositions with reasons and admits only real selectable text, as specified in evolution.md. Strict decoding preserves the original bytes rather than silently introducing replacement characters. The runtime data root is outside every Git repository (including another checkout or Git metadata directory), checked against its nearest existing real parent before creation; checking only the app's current checkout is insufficient.

An authenticated reply requires one to twenty valid evidence anchors, nonempty trimmed body (at most 64 KiB UTF-8) and nonempty explicit limitations (at most 8 KiB); saying that no additional limit is known must itself be explicit. Questions are nonempty after trimming and at most 16 KiB. Multiple additive replies may address one question; command identity prevents retry duplication, while a new command intentionally creates another reply. No answer replaces an earlier answer.

Reading the addressed inbox is a durable observation: selected items are marked read and their questions marked working. It never deletes an item, changes its cursor, erases attempts or creates a wake request. Repeating the same cursor returns the same eligible references; using the returned nextCursor advances the reader's view. Restart retains read/working state. `working` means the attachment has fetched the request, not that native turn execution was independently observed. Display priority is Answered, Working, Delivery unknown, Notified, failed attention, delivery pending, then saved/unattached. Notification details remain visible independently of that summary; an answer or inbox read cannot turn unknown delivery into notified.

Claude cannot receive this Codex proof; its trusted setup remains unrun in the absent Claude environment.

## Review-driven recovery corrections

Preparation is idempotent for an identical retained snapshot and rejects conflicting setup input. Advancing current uses AddSnapshot, never repeated setup. SQLite is authoritative: startup reconstructs and verifies the original pinned Git objects against retained history, ensures the database record exists, then exports the authoritative current snapshot without rewinding. [Continuation and verified preparation](evolution.md#continuation-derivation-contract-02b) define migration, the internal verification witness and identity compatibility. A crash/export failure after database commit must recover without deleting saved discussion; an export alone is never trusted as proof of database preparation.

AskQuestion recovery follows this current authoritative table. HTTP status alone never releases an already uncertain identity; analysis/import command retry policies remain separately scoped in their owning contracts.

| Observation | Effect certainty and retained state | Next explicit action |
|---|---|---|
| Local anchor/text/request-bound validation fails before write/send | Known unsent; keep the editable draft. No POST. | Correct the draft and submit. |
| Mandatory pending write/readback fails before the first POST | Known unsent; keep the draft and reserved in-memory intent, report storage failure. No mutation effect. | Retry its checkpoint before sending; never use a memory-only durability fallback. |
| Exact pending request is checkpointed; acknowledgement is lost, malformed, mismatching, or HTTP400/401/403 fails | Commit may have occurred. Keep the original request bytes/command ID/draft/scope; command_conflict also preserves uncertainty. | Authenticate with the original credential and explicitly recover the unchanged command. No automatic resend or retarget. |
| Matching authoritative rejected receipt, excluding command_conflict | That exact request was rejected. Remove only its matching pending guard; retain its draft. A malformed rejection is not authoritative. | Correct through a new explicit intent/command identity. |
| Matching applied receipt; exact question readback absent or unavailable | Retain accepted-awaiting-readback and receipt questionId/minimum revision. If receipt persistence fails, retain the older durable awaiting-ack record and honest in-memory receipt. | Explicit recovery reads the original source only; accepted state performs no POST. |
| Exact questionId/actor/trimmed text/full anchor/parent confirmed at the minimum | Invalidate/verify only the original private draft ID, preserving the other draft, then remove/verify the matching pending record. Clear failure keeps recovery conservatively. | Continue or explicitly choose the other draft. Revision alone is insufficient. |

The [private recovery contract](story-and-exploration.md#pending-question-recovery-across-reload) defines tab-local envelopes, exact browser-origin local-owner scope (legacy credential scopes remain preserved), mandatory write-ahead ordering, quarantine and limits. Lifecycle/access errors cannot erase uncertainty. Saved questions are immutable; deliberate side/range edits apply only to an unsent draft in its held comparison, never to a submitted request.

Authorized attachment replacement/reconnect transfers unanswered durable inbox items to the new generation while retaining their event IDs/cursors and the complete original notification history/destination. Questions already answered do not become new wake requests. A previously claimed unknown/notified event is visible to the new authorized inbox but never automatically re-notified merely because the attachment changed. Newly saved unaddressed questions gain an item normally. The new generation begins inbox reading at cursor zero, explicitly returned as `inboxCursor: 0` by session_attach; stale credentials remain fenced.

Manual preparation resolves each pinned `commit:path` to a Git **blob** before reading bytes. For legacy single-path preparation, trees, missing objects, NUL-containing binary content and invalid UTF-8 reject as `source_unavailable` before any source input, snapshot or review is persisted. Multi-file preparation retains such changed-side dispositions with reasons and admits only real selectable text, as specified in evolution.md. Strict decoding preserves the original bytes rather than silently introducing replacement characters. The runtime data root is outside every Git repository (including another checkout or Git metadata directory), checked against its nearest existing real parent before creation; checking only the app's current checkout is insufficient.


## Discussion and inbox semantics

An authenticated reply requires one to twenty valid evidence anchors, nonempty trimmed body (at most 64 KiB UTF-8) and nonempty explicit limitations (at most 8 KiB); saying that no additional limit is known must itself be explicit. Questions are nonempty after trimming and at most 16 KiB. Multiple additive replies may address one question; command identity prevents retry duplication, while a new command intentionally creates another reply. No answer replaces an earlier answer.

Reading the addressed inbox is a durable observation: selected items are marked read and their questions marked working. It never deletes an item, changes its cursor, erases attempts or creates a wake request. Repeating the same cursor returns the same eligible references; using the returned nextCursor advances the reader's view. Restart retains read/working state. `working` means the attachment has fetched the request, not that native turn execution was independently observed. Display priority is Answered, Working, Delivery unknown, Notified, failed attention, delivery pending, then saved/unattached. Notification details remain visible independently of that summary; an answer or inbox read cannot turn unknown delivery into notified.
